title: Z-Image-Turbo joins image generation
summary:
Z-Image-Turbo gained an upscaled image path, generated images lost their logo, and Enter made the legacy-auth transition clearer.

Added the self-hosted `zimage` model with 2× upscaling and dedicated request routing. Generated images also no longer receive a Pollinations logo, so the `nologo` parameter was removed.

The legacy auth site now names December 15, 2025 at 00:00 UTC as its closing time and directs users to Enter. Existing tokens will stop working, and data will not be migrated. Enter also added community links beneath its header logo.

Pack checkout now looks up products by slug rather than configured IDs. Enter’s pricing table makes units and model capabilities easier to read.

highlights.title: Z-Image-Turbo with upscaling
highlights.text: Generate images with `zimage`, an alpha text-to-image model that uses 2× upscaling. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=zimage).
